Attached: 1 video

Your AI Agents do not need memory that degrades as tasks scale. Hyperdata (RDF graphs in Turtle, with predicates like rdfs:seeAlso) turns passive text into instructions agents can follow, and AI Agents can now write the Turtle from plain-language rules. Start with Virtuoso, and treat the web as an executable operating environment for agents, not a passive library.
